title: Power Apps: Form fill assistance using speech as input in model-driven apps
description:
We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use speech as a source, providing users a more natural way to fill forms. Users select the microphone icon, record their content, and the transcript is used as a source for the form entry. Recordings are transient and not saved.

Availability

Field
Value

Release Channel
Monthly

Version
2612.1

Applies to
Model-driven apps

Feature Scope
Users (enabled by default)
